scope: Finite representative byte forms across the five AMD64 architectural subsets. Family presence does not establish exhaustive mnemonics, encodings, CPU features, privilege states, exceptions, modes, or hardware correctness.
sourcePolicy: BAP remains the sole production semantic provider. Unsupported or unexercised cases are not supported instructions; LLVM decode facts alone establish no effects.
encodingSource: GNU assembler (GNU Binutils for Ubuntu) 2.42, --64, Intel syntax; one instruction per ELF section. No machine instructions are executed.

references.title: AMD64 Architecture Programmer Manual Volume 3: General-Purpose and System Instructions
references.scope: General-purpose and system instruction taxonomy; revision 3.37 search-indexed official metadata. Existing repository manual pin is tests/bap/fixtures/amd-manuals.lock.json.

references.title: AMD64 Architecture Programmer Manual Volume 4: 128-Bit, 256-Bit, and 512-Bit Media Instructions
references.scope: Media instruction taxonomy, revision 3.26 official search-indexed metadata; does not claim every extension form is enumerated here.

references.title: AMD64 Architecture Programmer Manual Volume 5: 64-Bit Media and x87 Floating-Point Instructions
references.scope: Five architectural subsets and 64-bit media/x87 scope, revision 3.16 official search-indexed content; direct PDF retrieval was unavailable during authoring.
